note: N°7 plates (oud), kit single photoreal style. Tool: Nano Banana (Gemini app, Chrome), 27 Nov 2026, full-size download 1536x2752. Every prompt = 'Generate an image, vertical 9:16. ' + subject + styleSuffix. Three came letterboxed or with a blurred fill: cropped to their real picture (*_c.jpg, see setup.sh).
styleSuffix: Cinematic photoreal still, shot on 35mm film, fine film grain, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, soft creamy bokeh, warm amber and deep brown palette with deep plum shadows, natural textures, luxury fragrance campaign mood. Vertical 9:16 full-frame composition with the subject in the middle third and calm, darker space at the top and bottom for type. No painting, no illustration, no fantasy, no cartoon, no 3D render look, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no watermark, no faces, no people.

pv_forest.subject: A dense tropical rainforest in Southeast Asia at dawn, tall slender Aquilaria trees with smooth pale grey bark rising into mist, shafts of soft light through the canopy, ferns in the foreground.

pv_wound.subject: Extreme close-up of a tree trunk with a fresh wound in its smooth grey bark, the exposed pale wood streaked with dark brown-black resin veins, a few glossy amber resin beads, moss nearby, soft rainforest light.

pv_agarwood.subject: Close-up still life of dark agarwood chips, pale wood densely streaked with deep brown-black resin, resting on dark plum velvet beside a small empty glass dish, warm side light. The image must fill the whole vertical frame edge to edge, no black bars.

pv_incense.subject: A thin sliver of dark agarwood smouldering on a small celadon ceramic incense burner on a dark lacquered wooden table, a single thin ribbon of white smoke curling upward into darkness, warm low light. Tall vertical portrait framing that fills the whole frame, the smoke rising through the upper half.

pv_felled.subject: A felled tree trunk lying on the rainforest floor, seen close and from slightly above, its fresh cut cross-section showing pale wood with irregular dark brown resin streaks near the centre, scattered wood chips, misty jungle behind. Tall vertical portrait framing that fills the whole frame edge to edge.

pv_plantation.subject: A tropical tree plantation of young slender agarwood trees in neat rows, close on one smooth grey trunk in the foreground with a neat vertical line of small drilled holes, each plugged with a small wooden peg, a little dark resin around the holes, soft morning light and mist between the rows. Tall vertical portrait framing that fills the whole frame edge to edge.
